maddeler.e: سَانْت فِينْسِنْت وَجُزُر غْرِينَادِين • (sānt fīnsint wajuzur ḡrīnādīn) f
g: alternative form of سَانْت فِينْسِنْت وَالْغْرِينَادِين (sānt fīnsint wālḡrīnādīn): Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (an archipelago and country in the Caribbean, comprising the islands of Saint Vincent and the island chain of the Grenadines)
